name: handoff
description: Writes a handoff document from the live transcript when the context fills past a threshold (or on /handoff), then clears the context and resumes from the handoff — a fresh session without retyping anything.

threshold.description: Context fill (percent of the window) at which the handoff is written automatically after the turn ends.
threshold.title: Auto-handoff threshold (%)

handoffDir.description: Directory for handoff files, relative to the project root (e.g. `claude` for a team-lead repo).
handoffDir.title: Handoff directory

autoClear.description: After writing the handoff, run /clear and submit the resume prompt so work continues in a fresh context.
autoClear.title: Clear and resume after the handoff

minTurns.description: Never hand off automatically before this many user prompts in the session.
minTurns.title: Minimum prompts before auto-handoff

language.description: Language of the handoff document and the resume prompt.
language.title: Language
